highlights.brief: 该临床试验评估EEG神经反馈BCI改善儿童青少年认知功能，提供非侵入式干预证据。

items.title_zh: 使用脑机接口神经反馈进行认知康复
items.title_en: Cognitive Rehabilitation Using Neurofeedback With Brain-computer Interface
bullets_zh: ClinicalTrials.gov研究NCT07828496评估基于EEG的BCI神经反馈训练用于认知康复。
该试验面向存在认知障碍的儿童和青少年，使用非侵入式EEG作为客观指标。
发布于2026-09-18；为消费级非侵入式BCI干预提供临床证据。
bullets_en: ClinicalTrials.gov study NCT07828496 evaluates EEG-based BCI neurofeedback training for cognitive rehabilitation.
The trial targets children and adolescents with cognitive impairment, using non-invasive EEG as an objective marker.
Published 2026-09-18; relevant to clinical evidence for consumer-style non-invasive BCI interventions.
items.brief: 该临床试验评估EEG神经反馈BCI改善儿童青少年认知功能，提供非侵入式干预证据。
items.brief_en: This clinical trial evaluates EEG-based BCI neurofeedback to improve cognitive outcomes in children and adolescents.
